modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Carry-on must fit under the seat in front of you or in an overhead locker.

weight_e170.value: Embraer E170 jet: airfares include a complimentary 9kg carry-on allowance for each adult and child. If connecting to an E120, the E120 rules apply.

weight_e120.value: Embraer E120: airfares include a complimentary 4kg carry-on allowance for each adult and child.

personal_item.value: In addition, one small personal item such as a handbag, laptop computer, overcoat, small camera, reading material or a small amount of duty-free goods.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: All Airnorth flights include free checked baggage, for every class.

allowance_domestic_jet.value: Domestic flights on Embraer E170/E190 jets: free 20kg checked allowance for each adult and child (except infants).

allowance_international.value: International flights, all aircraft: free 30kg checked allowance for each adult and child (except infants).

allowance_e120.value: Embraer E120 aircraft: free 15kg checked allowance for each adult and child (except infants).

max_piece_weight.value: One piece of baggage must not exceed 32kg.

child_infant_items.value: Each child travelling with an adult can also check two child items (such as a car seat or stroller) up to 10kg each; infants can check up to three infant items free, up to 20kg in total.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Airnorth's conditions of carriage separate changes within its control from events beyond its control.

rebooking_refund.value: For a significant change within Airnorth's control, it rebooks you on the next available Airnorth flight to your destination at no extra cost or, at your option, refunds the applicable fare. For a significant change (4 hours +) beyond its control, it uses reasonable endeavours to rebook you, or refunds the fare if it cannot rebook you on services acceptable to you.

meals_accommodation.value: For a significant change within its control on the day of travel, Airnorth provides meal or refreshment vouchers (or reimburses reasonable costs); if you are delayed overnight at an 'away' port, it uses reasonable endeavours to help find accommodation or reimburses reasonable accommodation costs.

domestic_cutoff.value: Domestic flights: complete check-in at least 60 minutes and no later than 30 minutes before departure. From Melbourne Airport (Terminal 4): at least 90 minutes and no later than 30 minutes before.

international_cutoff.value: International flights: complete check-in at least 90 minutes and no later than 45 minutes before departure.

online_checkin.value: Web check-in opens 24 hours before departure. Passengers with checked bags must still go to an Airnorth counter; passengers on Qantas or other carrier travel documents cannot use web check-in.

phone_home_market.notes: Listed under 'Get in touch with Airnorth' on Airnorth's own pages.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
